clusters.notes: Set 001 of 5. API-05 (api_table_driven) variant uses lookup array (array_flip + isset) instead of if/else-if chain for role and grant checks. The lookup-array vs explicit-condition difference means token-based detectors will struggle to find shared token sequences beyond basic structure.
